title: Mocking Dependencies with Mockito
description: Isolate units of code by mocking collaborators with Mockito.

slides.title: Why Mock? 🎭
slides.content:
# Isolate the Class Under Test

When testing a service, you don't want to hit a real database or external API. **Mocks** simulate dependencies, allowing you to control their behavior and verify interactions.

Mockito is the most popular mocking framework in Java.

quizData.question: What is the primary purpose of mocking in unit tests?

options.text: To isolate the unit under test from its dependencies

quizData.explanation: Mocks replace real dependencies so you can focus on the logic of the unit being tested, without side effects.

slides.title: Mockito Basics
Annotations @Mock and @InjectMocks
slides.content: Use `@Mock` to create mocks, and `@InjectMocks` to inject them into the object under test. Enable with `@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)`.
